English: <squish=0.82>You know where you can find more Banana Coins? EVERYWHERE.

English: <squish=0.82>Don’t have enough Banana Coins? I wish I could say I was surprised.

English: <squish=0.82>Now, off you go! See if you can't finish this quest without my help!

English: <squish=0.82>It's about time you visited your frail, old Grandpa! Give me some of those shiny Banana Coins, and you can pick through my old things.

Italian: <squish=0.82>ERA ORA CHE FACESSI|VISITA AL TUO POVERO,|VECCHIO NONNO! PUOI|PRENDERTI UN PO' DELLA|MIA ROBA IN CAMBIO DI|QUALCHE MONETA BANANA.
Spanish: <squish=0.82>¡Ya era hora de que vinieras a visitar a tu anciano abuelito! Dame unas cuantas monedas plátano bien relucientes y te daré algunas cosillas.
Turkish: <squish=0.82>Nihayet ihtiyar, çelimsiz dedeni|ziyarete geldin!|Şu parlak Muz Paralarından biraz ver de|eski eşyalarımı karıştır.

English: <squish=0.82>Keep an eye out for some replacement rocking-chair material. This one chafes.
French: <squish=0.82>PRÉVIENS-MOI SI TU|TROUVES UN ROCKING-CHAIR|DE RECHANGE DANS LES|PARAGES : CELUI-CI GRINCE.
German: <squish=0.82>Halte Ausschau nach einem Ersatzschaukelstuhl. Dieser hier ist schon total durchgesessen.
Italian: <squish=0.82>VEDI UN PO' SE RIESCI A|TROVARE UNA SEDIA A|DONDOLO NUOVA.|QUESTA QUI NON|LA SOPPORTO PIÙ!

Turkish: <squish=0.82>Şu sallanan koltuğa yedek malzeme|görürsen getir.|Bu artık fena rahatsız ediyor.

English: <squish=0.82>Spiders! Spiders! There’s one on my chair! Ack!

Italian: <squish=0.82>RAGNI E ANCORA RAGNI! CE N'È|UNO ANCHE SULLA MIA SEDIA!|AAAH!
Spanish: <squish=0.82>¡¡¡Arañas!!! ¡Se me ha subido una a la silla! ¡Qué asco!

English: <squish=0.82>Nothing I like better than a relaxing stay in the forest. With spiders. And carnivorous plants. And deadly heights.
French: <squish=0.82>RIEN NE VAUT UN SÉJOUR|RELAXANT EN FORÊT.|AVEC DES ARAIGNÉES.|ET DES PLANTES CARNIVORES.|ET DES HAUTEURS|VERTIGINEUSES...

Italian: <squish=0.82>NON C'È NIENTE DI MEGLIO DI|UN SOGGIORNO RILASSANTE|NELLA FORESTA. IN|COMPAGNIA DI RAGNI...|PIANTE CARNIVORE E...|PERICOLOSI BARATRI.
Spanish: <squish=0.82>Ah, ¡qué relajante es este bosque! Con sus arañas. Y sus plantas carnívoras. Y el riesgo de caerte al vacío.
Turkish: <squish=0.82>Ormanda dinlendirici bir tatilden|güzeli yok.|Örümceklerle. Etçil bitkilerle.|Ve ölümcül yüksekliklerle.

English: <squish=0.82>Close the door! I don’t want any of those spiders getting in here.
French: <squish=0.82>FERME LA PORTE !|JE NE VEUX PAS ÊTRE|ENVAHI PAR LES ARAIGNÉES !
German: <squish=0.82>Mach die Tür zu! Ich will nicht, dass die Spinnen von draussen reinkommen.

Spanish: <squish=0.82>¡Cierra la puerta! No quiero que se cuelen aquí esas asquerosas arañas.

English: <squish=0.82>Well, you've amazed your old Grandpa by getting this far!
French: <squish=0.82>EH BEN, TON VIEUX PAPI|EST IMPRESSIONNÉ :|JE NE PENSAIS PAS QUE|TU IRAIS AUSSI LOIN !
German: <squish=0.82>Du hast deinen alten Opa ganz schön überrascht, indem du es bis hierher geschafft hast!
Italian: <squish=0.82>BEH, SEI RIUSCITO|A STUPIRE IL TUO|VECCHIO NONNETTO,|ARRIVANDO FINO|A QUI!
Spanish: <squish=0.82>¡Vaya! Qué sorpresa ver que has llegado hasta aquí.
Turkish: <squish=0.82>Vay canına, buraya kadar gelerek|ihtiyar dedeni şaşırttın!

German: <squish=0.82>Lass dich nicht von den Tikis schnappen! He he he!

English: <squish=0.82>Make sure to shut the gate on your way out. I didn't raise you in a barn!
French: <squish=0.82>N'OUBLIE PAS DE FERMER|LA PORTE EN SORTANT.|ON N'EST PAS DANS|UN MOULIN, ICI !
German: <squish=0.82>Schliess das Tor hinter dir, wenn du rausgehst! Ich hab dich schliesslich nicht in einer Scheune grossgezogen, oder?
Italian: <squish=0.82>RICORDATI DI CHIUDERE LA|PORTA QUANDO ESCI. NON|DIMENTICARE LE BUONE|MANIERE!
Spanish: <squish=0.82>Cierra la puerta al salir. ¡En mi familia debemos ser todos muy educados!

English: <squish=0.82>Can't say I expect to see you again, but you might get lucky, I guess.
French: <squish=0.82>JE NE M'ATTENDS PAS|VRAIMENT À TE REVOIR...|MAIS BON, ON VERRA SI|LA CHANCE TE SOURIT|OU PAS...
German: <squish=0.82>Ich erwarte wohl kaum, dich wiederzusehen, aber vielleicht hast du ja Glück.
Italian: <squish=0.82>NON MI ASPETTO DI|RIVEDERTI, MA|POTRESTI AVERE|FORTUNA, DOPOTUTTO.
Spanish: <squish=0.82>No sé si volveré a verte, pero quizá tengas suerte y todo.
Turkish: <squish=0.82>Seni tekrar göreceğimi pek sanmıyorum|ama belki şansın yaver gider.

English: <squish=0.82>Good luck, kid. From the looks of you, you’re going to need it.

English: <squish=0.82>If you see that old rhino fella out there, tell him to stop by.

Spanish: <squish=0.82>Si ves por ahí a Rambi, ese viejo rinoceronte, dile que venga a visitarme, ¿eh?

English: <squish=0.82>Now get out there and give those little drum guys what for. Yes, I said "what for". I’m old. Get over it.

Italian: <squish=0.82>ORA VA' E DA' A QUEI|TAMBURI UNA LEZIONE|ESEMPLARE. HAI SENTITO|BENE. SONO ANTIQUATO,|FATTENE UNA RAGIONE.
Spanish: <squish=0.82>Ve y dales a esos tamborcillos con patas una buena tunda. Sí, "tunda". Los mayores usamos esas palabras.
Turkish: <squish=0.82>Şimdi çık da şu davulcu ufaklıklara|hadlerini bildir.|Evet, “hadlerini bildir” dedim.|Yaşlıyım, alış buna.

English: <squish=0.82>Glad I could help my grandson overcome this deadly challenge in exchange for a little cash money.

English: <squish=0.82>They say there is a banana out there that not only tastes great, but also warps you to an alternate dimension. I say, "Yes, please!"

German: <squish=0.82>Man sagt, es gäbe da draussen eine Banane, die nicht nur toll schmeckt, sondern dich auch in eine andere Dimension katapultiert. Aber gerne, immer her damit!
Italian: <squish=0.82>DICONO CHE ESISTA UNA|BANANA NON SOLTANTO|DELIZIOSA, MA ANCHE CAPACE|DI CATAPULTARTI IN UN'ALTRA|DIMENSIONE. IO DICO, BUON|PRO TI FACCIA!

English: <squish=0.82>When in doubt, pound! Or jump. Or blow. Or whatever. I’m sure you’ll figure it out.

German: <squish=0.82>Wenn du nicht weiterweisst, trommele auf den Boden! Oder springe. Oder puste. Was auch immer! Ich bin sicher, du kommst schon dahinter.

English: <squish=0.82>Come back with fistfuls of Banana Coins or don’t come back at all!

English: <squish=0.82>It sure looks dangerous out there. See ya!
French: <squish=0.82>ÇA M'A L'AIR FRANCHEMENT|DANGEREUX DANS LE COIN.|À PLUS !

English: <squish=0.82>Keep your eyes open for those KONG letters. They might be worth something!
French: <squish=0.82>PENSE À RASSEMBLER|LES LETTRES KONG.|ELLES DOIVENT BIEN|SERVIR À QUELQUE CHOSE !

English: <squish=0.82>What do you want, eh? I'm a busy ape, I am!

English: <squish=0.82>Can you believe the shack they stuck me in?!
French: <squish=0.82>T'AS VU LE TAUDIS DANS|LEQUEL ON M'A MIS ?

Spanish: <squish=0.82>Seguro que no vas a llegar mucho más allá...

English: <squish=0.82>They stopped paying my pension ages ago. Now I’m reduced to selling junk out of this old shack.

English: <squish=0.82>Shut the door! You’re letting out all the cold air.

English: <squish=0.82>Back for more, are you? I knew you couldn’t make it without my help.

English: <squish=0.82>Tell those Tikis to keep it down! I’m an old ape, and I need my rest.

English: <squish=0.82>So, who hasn’t stolen your bananas at this point?

French: <squish=0.82>« OH, CRANKY, J'AI BESOIN|D'AIDE ! OH, CRANKY, TU PEUX|ME VENDRE UN PERROQUET ? »|PFFF...
German: <squish=0.82>„Oh Cranky, ich brauche deine Hilfe! Oh Cranky, kannst du mir einen Papagei verkaufen?“ Tststs!

English: <squish=0.82>Blood may be thicker than water, but Banana Coins are thicker still. Get in here.
French: <squish=0.82>LES LIENS DU SANG SONT|PLUS FORTS QUE TOUT...|MAIS LES PIÈCES BANANES,|ÇA RAPPROCHE AUSSI !|ENTRE DONC !

Spanish: <squish=0.82>La familia es lo más importante para mí, pero necesito tus monedas plátano. Venga, a ver qué me compras...

English: <squish=0.82>Let me know if you find the golden banana! I hear it’s glorious!

English: <squish=0.82>Come on in! I got heart boosts, magic potions, and more balloons than you can shake Diddy at!
